title: A Short Proof of Twin-Quotient Decomposition and Orbit Lifting
content: We give a short proof of the known automorphism-group decomposition associated with the maximal twin classes of a finite simple undirected graph. Colouring each quotient vertex by class size and internal adjacency type gives a split surjection from the original automorphism group, with kernel the product of the symmetric groups on the classes. We derive explicit formulas for lifting vertex and edge orbits. Edge orbits comprise lifts of quotient edge orbits and a separate family of internal clique-edge orbits. The same formulas apply to every subgroup of the colour-preserving quotient group, yielding lower bounds on individual orbit sizes and upper bounds on the numbers of orbits.
